title: Context-aware cockpit interaction for safer decisions
summary: 今天聚焦智能座舱如何根据驾驶状态、环境信息和用户意图调整界面优先级，适合积累设计评审和方案汇报表达。

words.meaning: 情境感知界面；能根据用户状态、环境和任务动态调整的界面
words.example: A context-aware interface can reduce visual demand when the vehicle enters a complex junction.
words.chineseExample: 当车辆进入复杂路口时，情境感知界面可以降低视觉负担。

words.meaning: 驾驶员工作负荷；驾驶中认知、视觉和操作压力的总和
words.example: The team measured driver workload before adding another layer of alerts.
words.chineseExample: 团队在增加另一层提醒之前，先测量了驾驶员工作负荷。

words.meaning: 一瞥可读性；用户短暂扫视即可理解信息的能力
words.example: Glanceability is critical for speed, range, and navigation prompts.
words.chineseExample: 车速、续航和导航提示的一瞥可读性非常关键。

words.meaning: 交互优先级；不同功能、提示或任务在界面中的优先顺序
words.example: Interaction priority should change when a safety-critical event is detected.
words.chineseExample: 当检测到安全关键事件时，交互优先级应该发生变化。

words.meaning: 接管请求；自动驾驶或辅助驾驶系统要求驾驶员接管控制的提示
words.example: A takeover request must be clear across visual, auditory, and haptic channels.
words.chineseExample: 接管请求必须在视觉、听觉和触觉通道上都足够清晰。

words.meaning: 多模态反馈；通过视觉、声音、触觉等多个通道提供反馈
words.example: Multimodal feedback helps users confirm an action without staring at the screen.
words.chineseExample: 多模态反馈帮助用户在不盯着屏幕的情况下确认操作。

words.meaning: 信息层级；界面信息按重要性和使用频率组织的结构
words.example: The information hierarchy separates driving-critical data from comfort controls.
words.chineseExample: 信息层级把驾驶关键数据和舒适性控制区分开来。

words.meaning: 认知阻力；用户理解、判断或完成任务时遇到的额外心理成本
words.example: Ambiguous icons create cognitive friction during time-sensitive tasks.
words.chineseExample: 含义模糊的图标会在时间敏感任务中制造认知阻力。

words.meaning: 渐进披露；按需展示信息，避免一次性暴露过多选项
words.example: Progressive disclosure keeps advanced settings available but out of the main driving view.
words.chineseExample: 渐进披露让高级设置保持可用，但不占据主要驾驶视图。

words.meaning: 安全关键提醒；与碰撞、接管、系统失效等高风险情境相关的提示
words.example: A safety-critical alert should never compete visually with entertainment content.
words.chineseExample: 安全关键提醒不应该在视觉上与娱乐内容竞争。

glossary.meaning: 设计良好的；经过清晰目标和使用场景验证的
glossary.example: A well-designed cockpit reduces unnecessary steps.
glossary.chineseExample: 设计良好的座舱会减少不必要的操作步骤。

glossary.meaning: 智能的；能根据情境、数据或用户意图做出响应的
glossary.example: An intelligent system can adapt to the driving context.
glossary.chineseExample: 智能系统可以适应驾驶情境。

glossary.meaning: 座舱；驾驶员和乘员与车辆系统交互的空间
glossary.example: The cockpit combines displays, controls, and feedback.
glossary.chineseExample: 座舱整合了显示、控制和反馈。

glossary.meaning: 功能；系统提供给用户完成任务的能力
glossary.example: Every function should have a clear user value.
glossary.chineseExample: 每个功能都应该有清晰的用户价值。

glossary.meaning: 更大的；尺寸或范围更大
glossary.example: A larger screen does not automatically improve usability.
glossary.chineseExample: 更大的屏幕并不一定自动提升可用性。

glossary.meaning: 理解；识别用户意图、任务或情境
glossary.example: The system should understand what the driver is trying to do.
glossary.chineseExample: 系统应该理解驾驶员想要完成什么。

glossary.meaning: 驾驶；与车辆行驶和道路环境相关的活动
glossary.example: Driving tasks must remain the primary focus.
glossary.chineseExample: 驾驶任务必须始终是主要关注点。

glossary.meaning: 情境；影响交互判断的环境、任务和用户状态
glossary.example: Context determines which information should be shown first.
glossary.chineseExample: 情境决定哪些信息应该优先展示。

glossary.meaning: 根据；依据某个条件或规则
glossary.example: The layout changes according to speed and road complexity.
glossary.chineseExample: 布局会根据车速和道路复杂度变化。

glossary.meaning: 时刻；某个具体时间点或交互发生的瞬间
glossary.example: At that moment, the warning should be more prominent.
glossary.chineseExample: 在那个时刻，警告应该更加突出。

glossary.meaning: 巡航；车辆以较稳定状态行驶
glossary.example: When cruising, the interface can stay calm and minimal.
glossary.chineseExample: 巡航时，界面可以保持克制和简洁。

glossary.meaning: 续航里程；车辆还能行驶的距离
glossary.example: Range should be visible without distracting the driver.
glossary.chineseExample: 续航信息应可见但不分散驾驶员注意力。

glossary.meaning: 媒体；音乐、播客、视频等娱乐内容
glossary.example: Media controls should not compete with safety alerts.
glossary.chineseExample: 媒体控制不应与安全提醒争夺注意力。

glossary.meaning: 可见的；用户无需搜索即可看到的
glossary.example: Critical status should remain visible in the main view.
glossary.chineseExample: 关键状态应该在主视图中保持可见。

glossary.meaning: 平静的、克制的；不制造干扰的界面状态
glossary.example: A calm interface helps drivers stay focused.
glossary.chineseExample: 克制平静的界面帮助驾驶员保持专注。

glossary.meaning: 接近；车辆靠近某个位置或情境
glossary.example: As the vehicle approaches a junction, guidance becomes more important.
glossary.chineseExample: 当车辆接近路口时，引导信息会变得更重要。

glossary.meaning: 密集的；交通、信息或视觉元素较多的
glossary.example: Dense traffic requires a simpler HMI layout.
glossary.chineseExample: 密集交通需要更简洁的 HMI 布局。

glossary.meaning: 路口；道路交汇处
glossary.example: At an intersection, lane guidance should be easy to read.
glossary.chineseExample: 在路口，车道引导应该容易读取。

glossary.meaning: 次要的；相对于驾驶主任务不那么关键的
glossary.example: Secondary choices should be reduced during complex driving.
glossary.chineseExample: 复杂驾驶时应减少次要选项。

glossary.meaning: 选项；用户可以选择的功能入口或操作
glossary.example: Too many choices slow down decision-making.
glossary.chineseExample: 过多选项会拖慢决策。

glossary.meaning: 突出显示；让重要信息更醒目
glossary.example: The system should highlight the next lane instruction.
glossary.chineseExample: 系统应该突出下一条车道指令。

glossary.meaning: 车道
glossary.example: Lane guidance helps the driver prepare earlier.
glossary.chineseExample: 车道引导帮助驾驶员更早做准备。

glossary.meaning: 引导；帮助用户完成判断或行动的信息
glossary.example: Clear guidance reduces uncertainty.
glossary.chineseExample: 清晰引导可以减少不确定性。

glossary.meaning: 感知、察觉；看见并理解信息
glossary.example: Alerts should be easy to perceive at a glance.
glossary.chineseExample: 提醒应该能一眼被感知。

glossary.meaning: 一瞥；短暂扫视
glossary.example: The driver should understand the warning with one glance.
glossary.chineseExample: 驾驶员应该能通过一瞥理解警告。

glossary.meaning: 设计师；负责定义体验、结构和交互的人
glossary.example: The designer should consider workload, trust, and safety.
glossary.chineseExample: 设计师应考虑负荷、信任和安全。

glossary.meaning: 功能特性；产品中可被用户使用或感知的能力
glossary.example: A feature is valuable only when it supports the task.
glossary.chineseExample: 只有支持任务的功能才有价值。

glossary.meaning: 令人印象深刻的；看起来很强或很炫的
glossary.example: An impressive animation may still increase distraction.
glossary.chineseExample: 炫酷动画仍可能增加分心。

glossary.meaning: 支持；帮助用户完成任务或降低负担
glossary.example: The interface should support quick decisions.
glossary.chineseExample: 界面应该支持快速决策。

glossary.meaning: 语音；通过说话完成输入或反馈的交互通道
glossary.example: Voice interaction can reduce manual input.
glossary.chineseExample: 语音交互可以减少手动输入。

glossary.meaning: 触觉的；通过震动、力反馈等触感传达信息的
glossary.example: Haptic feedback confirms the action without a long visual check.
glossary.chineseExample: 触觉反馈无需长时间看屏即可确认操作。

glossary.meaning: 指令；用户发出的操作请求
glossary.example: The command should be confirmed immediately.
glossary.chineseExample: 指令应该被即时确认。

glossary.meaning: 即时的；没有明显延迟的
glossary.example: Immediate feedback makes the interaction feel reliable.
glossary.chineseExample: 即时反馈会让交互更可靠。

glossary.meaning: 易懂的；不需要额外解释就能理解的
glossary.example: Warnings must be understandable under time pressure.
glossary.chineseExample: 警告在时间压力下也必须易懂。

glossary.meaning: 装饰性的；主要用于视觉美化而非功能支持的
glossary.example: Decorative details should not hide important information.
glossary.chineseExample: 装饰细节不应遮挡重要信息。

glossary.meaning: 信任；用户对系统可靠性和可预测性的判断
glossary.example: Consistent feedback builds trust in the cockpit system.
glossary.chineseExample: 一致的反馈会建立用户对座舱系统的信任。

glossary.meaning: 负荷；完成任务需要投入的认知、视觉和操作资源
glossary.example: A simpler flow reduces driver workload.
glossary.chineseExample: 更简单的流程会降低驾驶员负荷。

longReadings.text: A well-designed intelligent cockpit does not simply place more functions on a larger screen. It understands the driving context and changes the interface according to what matters most at that moment. When the car is cruising on an open road, the system can keep navigation, range, and media controls visible but calm. When the vehicle approaches a dense intersection, the cockpit should reduce secondary choices, highlight lane guidance, and make safety-related alerts easier to perceive at a glance. For an HMI designer, the key question is not whether a feature is impressive, but whether it supports the driver with the right level of attention. Voice interaction, touch controls, steering-wheel shortcuts, and haptic feedback should work together as one interaction system. If the driver needs to confirm a command, the feedback should be immediate and understandable without forcing a long visual check. This is why information hierarchy, glanceability, and multimodal feedback are not decorative details. They are design decisions that shape trust, workload, and safety inside the vehicle.
longReadings.translation: 一个优秀的智能座舱并不是简单地把更多功能放到更大的屏幕上。它要理解驾驶情境，并根据当下最重要的事情调整界面。当车辆在开阔道路巡航时，系统可以让导航、续航和媒体控制保持可见但不打扰。当车辆接近复杂路口时，座舱应该减少次要选项，突出车道引导，让安全相关提醒更容易被一眼识别。对 HMI 设计师来说，关键问题不是功能是否炫酷，而是它是否用合适的注意力成本支持驾驶员。语音、触控、方向盘快捷操作和触觉反馈应该共同组成一个交互系统。如果驾驶员需要确认指令，反馈应当即时且易懂，而不是迫使用户长时间看屏幕。因此，信息层级、一瞥可读性和多模态反馈不是装饰细节，而是影响车内信任、负荷和安全的设计决策。

source.label: 参考：A Brief Survey on Interactive Automotive UI

sentenceBreakdowns.sentence: It understands the driving context and changes the interface according to what matters most at that moment.
sentenceBreakdowns.structure: 主语 It + 并列谓语 understands / changes + 宾语 context / interface + according to 引导依据。
sentenceBreakdowns.focus: driving context 表示驾驶情境；what matters most 表示最重要的事情。
sentenceBreakdowns.pattern: The system changes X according to Y. 可用于描述自适应界面逻辑。

sentenceBreakdowns.sentence: The cockpit should reduce secondary choices, highlight lane guidance, and make safety-related alerts easier to perceive at a glance.
sentenceBreakdowns.structure: should + 三个并列动词 reduce / highlight / make，表达设计策略组合。
sentenceBreakdowns.focus: secondary choices 是次要选项；at a glance 是一眼即可。
sentenceBreakdowns.pattern: The interface should reduce A, highlight B, and make C easier to perceive.

sentenceBreakdowns.sentence: The key question is not whether a feature is impressive, but whether it supports the driver with the right level of attention.
sentenceBreakdowns.structure: not whether..., but whether... 对比句型，用于强调设计判断标准。
sentenceBreakdowns.focus: impressive 强调视觉或技术冲击；right level of attention 强调合适注意力成本。
sentenceBreakdowns.pattern: The key question is not whether X, but whether Y.

sentenceBreakdowns.sentence: They are design decisions that shape trust, workload, and safety inside the vehicle.
sentenceBreakdowns.structure: 主句 They are design decisions + that 定语从句说明影响对象。
sentenceBreakdowns.focus: shape 在这里是影响、塑造；trust, workload, and safety 是设计评审常用维度。
sentenceBreakdowns.pattern: These are design decisions that shape A, B, and C.

practiceSteps.title: 词汇朗读
practiceSteps.detail: 先读英文术语和音标，再用中文解释回忆含义。

practiceSteps.title: 长文跟读
practiceSteps.detail: 第一遍慢读理解，第二遍按意群跟读，第三遍尽量连贯复述。

practiceSteps.title: 句子拆解
practiceSteps.detail: 重点练习 not whether..., but whether... 和 reduce A, highlight B, make C easier to perceive。

practiceSteps.title: 口头改写
practiceSteps.detail: 用今天词汇描述一个车机首页或导航提醒的优化方案。
